description: Delete the authenticated user's most recent play log for a game. Walks played_at then created_at descending. Errors if there is no play to undo. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

name: kineticist_undo_last_play
title: Undo your last play
